text:
ana (Product): Heads-up — we need a quick cross-team sync on the tenant-priority rollout. Customer Beta wants private pilot in Q4; scope includes per-tenant quotas, pinned models, and HSM-backed keys. Can teams call out blockers and minimal acceptance criteria? @mike @cheng @lisa

sam (PM): High-level ask: 1) Pilot customers can pin 1 model variant, 2) per-tenant token quota + usage alerting, 3) SLA for latency p95. Need list of infra/runtime work to hit a canary.

mike (Runtime): From runtime side: main work is model-variant pinning + KV cache isolation per tenant. Also need a fallback flow when pinned model isn't available. Rough ETA: 3 sprints if no infra blockers.

cheng (Infra): Infra concerns: reserved GPU pool for pilot tenants + VPC peering for private pilots. We'll need a capacity slot assignment and prewarm policy. Question: do we require dedicated capacity or shared with shielding?

lisa (Security): Security checklist: HSM/KMS integration for tenant keys, audit logs for model pin actions, and data flow review. HSM procurement might add lead time — need to know if soft-HSM is acceptable for pilot.

ana (Product): (actually ana corrected) sorry typo earlier :) We can do soft-HSM for pilot if security triages it as "low risk" but must have HSM in roadmap. Pilot customer requires NDA and audit trail.

jen (Eng-SRE): Operational points: alerting for quota exhaustion, dashboard for per-tenant latency/cost, and runbook for fallback when pinned model degraded. We can reuse existing per-route dashboards but will need a tenant dimension.

sam (PM): let's distill acceptance criteria — can each team confirm these minimal gates?

ana (Product): acceptance criteria (minimal for pilot):
```
- Pinning API: create/list/delete pin for a tenant (api + auth)
- Quotas: soft quota enforcement with alerts, per-tenant usage dashboard
- Security: tenant key storage behind KMS (soft-HSM ok), audit logs enabled
- Infra: reserved capacity slot + prewarm policy for pinned workload
- Runtime: graceful fallback to shared variant with telemetry and per-tenant cache isolation
- Ops: alerts + runbook for quota/fallback incidents
```

mike (Runtime): I confirm runtime can deliver pinning API and fallback behavior in 2 sprints if infra provides capacity/reservation by start of sprint 1. Need an API contract — @sam can you add a quick OpenAPI sketch?

cheng (Infra): Capacity booking: we can carve out 1x A100-equivalent slot for the pilot starting in 3 weeks, but prewarm automation requires a small infra change (config toggle + cron). ETA: infra change in 2 weeks.

lisa (Security): I'll review soft-HSM design tomorrow. If we can accept soft-HSM for pilot we can avoid procurement lag. Will follow up with a short checklist in this thread.

sam (PM): I'll draft the API contract and a minimal product spec doc (will link). Also adding a short rollout plan: canary to 2 tenants -> expand to 5 -> full pilot. Each step gated by latency/cost/regression checks.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: staging/pin-api-service:build-2026-11-05 -> scheduled for 2026-11-07 02:00 UTC :robot_face:

ana (Product): Next steps: @sam create the API sketch and rollout playbook by EOD Fri; @cheng confirm capacity slot and prewarm toggle by end of week; @lisa post soft-HSM checklist; @mike estimate exact sprint scope. We'll run a 30m sync on Monday if any open blockers. :thumbsup:

mike (Runtime): ack. I'll post a brief tech note with endpoints and fallback states.

cheng (Infra): ack, I'll create infra ticket and assign.

lisa (Security): ack — will post checklist tomorrow.

jen (Eng-SRE): ack — I'll prototype dashboard dims and alerts.

sam (PM): thanks all. I'll ping for the Monday slot if we need it.
